attempted_claim: Let T, Sigma satisfy Assumption 1.1 of Caldini-Skorobogatova (arXiv:2504.19234): T is an m-dimensional integral current area-minimizing in a C^{3,kappa0} (m+nbar)-submanifold Sigma (nbar>=2), localized in B_{6 sqrt(m)}, 0 is a flat singular point of density Q>=2 with small tilt-excess/graphical hypothesis over a plane pi0. Let F_Q(T) be flat singular points of density Q and I(T,p) in [1,infinity) the Almgren singularity degree. Fix delta in (0,1/Q). Does F_Q(T) — equivalently its low-degree piece F_{Q,<=1+delta}(T), since F_{Q,>=1+delta}(T) already has such a bound by Theorem 1.4 there — satisfy a local uniform (m-2)-dimensional upper Minkowski content bound, i.e. do there exist r1=r1(m,nbar,Q,delta)>0 and C=C(m,nbar,Q,delta) with |B_r(F_Q(T) cap B_1)| <= C r^{nbar+2} for all r in (0,r1]?
decisive_failure: No proof or disproof of the target Minkowski bound was obtained; the low-degree piece resists all uniform methods attempted, and no independently valuable emergent claim was found. Artifacts are diagnostic scripts only, not verification of any new theorem.
